toxicity.Notes: Sub-acute systemic toxicity over 14 days in normal female Swiss albino mice: seven groups of six, the complex injected i.p. at 20, 25, 30, 50 and 100 mg/kg alongside untreated and vehicle controls, with blood taken by cardiac puncture after 14 days. The animals in every dose group, up to 100 mg/kg, showed no pathological changes and no significant change in SGOT, SGPT, alkaline phosphatase, urea or creatinine compared with the untreated group, and the discussion repeats that the complex imparts no significant toxic symptoms up to 100 mg/kg. MTD is therefore recorded as the censored bound >=100 mg/kg, the highest dose tested, and no LD50 was determined. The authors add that although 100 mg/kg is non-toxic they did not go beyond 50 mg/kg in the efficacy work because at 100 mg/kg the drug solution turned acidic. No body-weight series is given for the toxicity groups. The anticancer work in the same paper is an Ehrlich ascites carcinoma model in which the endpoint is life span, T/C 150 % at 30 mg/kg, so there is no tumour growth inhibition and no main row.
